mapper.select: SELECT id, username, title, content, name, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tasks ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks ( username, title, content, name, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{title}, #{content}, #{name}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
